name: maui-platform-backend
description: Guide .NET MAUI backend implementation for new platforms (GTK, AppKit, Avalonia, TUI, etc.) in the dotnet/maui-labs repository. USE FOR: creating a new MAUI backend, implementing a control handler, adding Essentials services, setting up build targets, scaffolding project structure, debugging handler rendering with DevFlow. DO NOT USE FOR: building or running existing MAUI apps (use maui-devflow-debug skill), DevFlow CLI/MCP tool development (see AGENTS.md). INVOKES: GitHub MCP tools for reference code, web_fetch for MAUI source and platform API docs.
